import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 210;
    static final int MAXM = 2 * MAXN * MAXN;
    static final int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
    static final int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};
    static final int S = MAXN - 2;
    static final int T = MAXN - 1;
    static final int INF = 2000 * 1000 * 1000;

    static class MaxFlow {
        int[] to = new int[MAXM];
        int[] flow = new int[MAXM];
        int[] cap = new int[MAXM];
        int lastEdge = 0;

        List<Integer>[] g = new List[MAXN];
        boolean[] used = new boolean[MAXN];

        MaxFlow() {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
                g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        void addEdge(int from, int to, int capacity) {
            this.to[lastEdge] = to;
            this.flow[lastEdge] = 0;
            this.cap[lastEdge] = capacity;
            g[from].add(lastEdge++);

            this.to[lastEdge] = from;
            this.flow[lastEdge] = 0;
            this.cap[lastEdge] = 0;
            g[to].add(lastEdge++);
        }

        boolean dfs(int v, int sink, int flowAmount) {
            if (v == sink) {
                return true;
            }

            used[v] = true;

            for (int idx : g[v]) {
                if (!used[to[idx]] && cap[idx] - flow[idx] >= flowAmount &&
                    dfs(to[idx], sink, flowAmount)) {
                    
                    flow[idx] += flowAmount;
                    flow[idx ^ 1] -= flowAmount;

                    return true;
                }
            }
            
            return false;
        }

        int getMaxFlow(int source, int sink) {
            int flowAmount = 1 << 30;
            int totalFlow = 0;

            while (flowAmount > 0) {
                if (dfs(source, sink, flowAmount)) {
                    totalFlow += flowAmount;
                } else {
                    flowAmount >>= 1;
                }

                Arrays.fill(used, false);
            }

            return totalFlow;
        }
    }

    static MaxFlow maxFlow = new MaxFlow();
    static int n, t;
    static char[][] grid1 = new char[15][15];
    static char[][] grid2 = new char[15][15];
    static int[][] distance = new int[15][15];
    static boolean[][] visited = new boolean[15][15];

    static boolean isValid(int x, int y) {
        return 0 <= x && x < n &&
               0 <= y && y < n &&
               grid1[x][y] != 'Y' &&
               grid1[x][y] != 'Z';
    }

    static void bfsDeath(int x, int y) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                distance[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }

        Queue<Integer> X = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> Y = new LinkedList<>();
        distance[x][y] = 0;
        X.add(x);
        Y.add(y);

        while (!X.isEmpty()) {
            assert !Y.isEmpty();

            int curx = X.poll();
            int cury = Y.poll();

            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int tx = curx + dx[k];
                int ty = cury + dy[k];

                if (isValid(tx, ty) && distance[tx][ty] == INF) {
                    distance[tx][ty] = distance[curx][cury] + 1;
                    X.add(tx);
                    Y.add(ty);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void runBFS(int x, int y) {
        Queue<Integer> X = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> Y = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> lev = new LinkedList<>();
        
        visited = new boolean[15][15];
        visited[x][y] = true;
        X.add(x);
        Y.add(y);
        lev.add(0);

        while (!X.isEmpty()) {
            assert !Y.isEmpty();

            int curx = X.poll();
            int cury = Y.poll();
            int curlev = lev.poll();

            if (Character.isDigit(grid2[curx][cury]) && grid2[curx][cury] != '0') {
                maxFlow.addEdge(x * n + y, n * n + 1 + curx * n + cury, INF);
            }
            
            if (curlev >= t) {
                continue;
            }

            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int tx = curx + dx[k];
                int ty = cury + dy[k];

                if (isValid(tx, ty) && !visited[tx][ty]) {
                    if (distance[tx][ty] > curlev + 1) {
                        X.add(tx);
                        Y.add(ty);
                        lev.add(curlev + 1);
                    } else if (distance[tx][ty] > curlev && Character.isDigit(grid2[tx][ty]) && grid2[tx][ty] != '0') {
                        maxFlow.addEdge(x * n + y, n * n + 1 + tx * n + ty, INF);
                    }

                    visited[tx][ty] = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void build() {
        int posi = -1, posj = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n && posi == -1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n && posi == -1; j++) {
                if (grid1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    posi = i;
                    posj = j;
                }
            }
        }

        bfsDeath(posi, posj);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(grid1[i][j]) && grid1[i][j] != '0') {
                    maxFlow.addEdge(S, i * n + j, grid1[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(grid2[i][j]) && grid2[i][j] != '0') {
                    maxFlow.addEdge(i * n + j + n * n + 1, T, grid2[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(grid1[i][j]) && grid1[i][j] != '0') {
                    runBFS(i, j);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        t = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);

        br.readLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            grid1[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }

        br.readLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            grid2[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }

        build();

        System.out.println(maxFlow.getMaxFlow(S, T));
    }
}
